Subject: Re: [ILUG] Interest in getting a EEEPC?

Dimensions: 225 × 165 × 21~35 mm (8.9 × 6.5 × 0.9~1.4 in)  according to
wikipedia 

the variance in size i believe is that the biggest version has a bigger
battery pack.

the only protocol that i think is missing on this is bluetooth.

used to have a psion myself so really hoping to get one of these little
beauties.  main difference barring colour screen is having access to linux
and wifi.  used to get around 20-30 wpm on the psions keyboards so hope i
can replicate that on this keyboard.

i only ever got about a week out of a psion on batteries but then i really
used that little thing.

moylan
